abstract: Power generation is crucial for providing electricity, which is a fundamental resource for daily life generating power is essential for various reasons, including meeting the energy demands of modern society, enabling technological advancements and supporting economic development. As Our project aim is to be generate power with the darrieus verti-axis windmill characterized by its vertical orientation and curved blades. It can capture wind from any direction making them suitable for changing wind conditions. The darrieus turbine often exhibit a high starting torque, means there can start rotating at lower wind speed. Now verti-axis wind turbine(VAWTs) generate power by converting the kinetic energy of wind into mechanical energy, and the Permanent magnetic generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy by using the various components in the wind mill. Such as blades, rotor, shaft, generator, tower and breaking system. The installation cost is also comparivity low even the availability of wind is low the start up wind speed is 3 m/s, the rated wind speed is 13 m/s and survival wind speed is 18 m/s. The power generator is of permanent magnet type which generates up to 15v A.C supply with the power of 200W.In conclusion we can generate the power at low wind speed, reliability of supply even with the low installation cost.

articleTitle: High-Performance Hybrid Circuit Breaker for HVDC Fault Interruption with SiC-MESFET and Vacuum Circuit Breaker
abstract: For overcoming problems related to timely fault isolation, power electronic switching devices have become progressively sophisticated. Such results are seemingly highlighted because of the recognition and growth of High Voltage DC Power. In relation to the mentioned advantage, a device namely; Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker (DCHCB) conjointly with devices based on semiconductor having a wide band gap, gives assistance to troubleshoot faults and minimize the effects of current, voltage and frequencies at high power ratings. Theoretically, as studies suggest that a fault interruption is evaluated as more critical when collated to a power system consisting of High Voltage AC (HVAC); a Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker as proposedly designed in this paper, is found to have been more efficient in dealing with the voltage and current and faults leading to the buildup for a mitigation technique for heavy transients for a system of high voltage. As mentioned earlier, this proposed design of DCHCB, amalgamates semiconductor switches for a coherent fault interruption. Diving in-depth to the designing scheme, the mechanical parts of the DCCB is enclosed by a Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB). Whereas the electronic switching component is involved in the function of SiC-MESFET. The latter results in more dominant and quicker switching operation when fault arises in the existing power system. The model is simulated using SIMULINK and the contrast results are drawn against existing systems.

articleTitle: An Innovative Hybrid Framework for Enhancing the Precision of Phishing Detection
abstract: Phishing attacks have posed a serious threat to the information security cyber world; where malicious websites try to beguile the actual identity of users. Attackers keep adopting new tactics for phishing sites over a while, making it challenging to detect new phishing sites. It has been based on a comparative study of various machine learning models, such as SVM, RandomForest (RF), CatBoost, Voting Classifier, and Stacking Classifier, toward their classification of phishing and nonphishing sites. Different experiments were performed on the dataset, which consisted of features of URLs. Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score measure performance. Among the various models used for evaluation, the best-performing classifier was the Stacking Classifier with an accuracy of 97.33%, precision value of 0.9684, recall of 0.9793, and F1 score of 0.9738 for the non-phishing websites. On the contrary, it outperformed the rest against phishing websites with a precision of 0.9785, recall of 0.9672, and F1 score of 0.9728. The ensemble approach due to the strengths from multiple base learners improves the classification performance much more than that from any of the individual base learners. This work realizes that there is a great need for future work based on the effectiveness of stacking techniques in phishing detection, and it has the potential to open the door for methods to enhance real-time detection systems against adversarial threats.

articleTitle: Disease Identification for Lac Crops using CNN Model
abstract: This research focuses on using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to accurately identify diseases in lac crops, a critical resource for economies like India, Thailand and some other countries, but challenging to diagnose traditionally. The primary aim is to develop and test a CNN model to replace manual inspections, improving disease management and reducing economic losses. The study involves creating a dataset of crop images, training the CNN, and testing its accuracy against existing methods. It also explores integrating the model with a web app for real-time crop monitoring. Ethical considerations like data privacy and unbiased model development are emphasized. This research promotes sustainable farming by reducing chemical use through precise disease management, empowering farmers, enhancing productivity, and supporting long-term agricultural resilience.

articleTitle: Intelligent Research Paper Recommendation System with Area-Aware Prediction Approach
abstract: This paper proposes a dual-task approach for comprehensive analysis and recommendation of this research paper by developing an optimized, high-accuracy model using advanced machine learning and natural language processing techniques. Large-scale classification of areas in research is done as the first task using a shallow Multi-Layer Perceptron model. Duplicates are removed while preprocessing dataset and filter the high-frequency terms by using term frequency so that classification is robust yet relevant. This gets transformed to multihot encoded vectors at the output from TensorFlow's StringLookup layer, which lets us train the model effectively with the help of an MLP. Therefore, the dataset is divided into training, testing, and validation sets to carefully check the model's efficiency and generalization abilities. The second task involves recommending relevant research papers; therefore, a sentence transformer model is exploited. It embeds the abstracts in some high-dimensional semantic space that captures nuanced similarities between the papers. This embedding process enables recommendations that are both precise and contextually relevant to user queries. This integrated approach encompasses not only the classification of research areas but also recommending research papers relevant to those areas. Hence, this is a very potent way to handle and explore large collections of academic papers. This approach significantly enhances the accuracy and optimization no longer found in traditional approaches; thus, it benefits the academic community in terms of fostering efficient workflow development in research.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Insights: Mall Customer Segmentation through Fuzzy C-Means Clustering
abstract: This study, employed the Fuzzy C-Means clustering algorithm to segment mall customers based on various demographic and spending attributes. Using a dataset of 200 mall customers, the study analyzed their annual income, spending score, and other relevant factors to identify distinct customer groups. The Fuzzy C-Means algorithm, which allows data points to belong to multiple clusters with varying degrees of membership, provided a nuanced segmentation that traditional clustering methods might miss. To enhance the interpretability of the results, the authors utilized Plotly, an interactive visualization tool, to create dynamic and insightful visual representations of the segmented data. The analysis revealed five distinct customer segments, each with unique characteristics and behaviors. The interactive plots facilitated a deeper understanding of the clustering results, enabling the identification of key patterns and trends within each segment. This segmentation can inform targeted marketing strategies and personalized customer experiences, potentially driving increased customer satisfaction and loyalty. The combination of Fuzzy C-Means clustering and Plotly visualization proved effective in uncovering complex relationships within the data, demonstrating the potential of these techniques in retail analytics and customer segmentation.

articleTitle: A Review of Audio Classification Techniques
abstract: Audio classification is a rapidly advancing field, driven by the increasing demand for intelligent audio processing systems in various applications such as speech recognition, environmental sound classification and music genre detection. This survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of audio classification techniques, focusing on machine learning methods, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and hybrid models. Traditional techniques including k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), Support Vector Machines (SVM) are reviewed for their foundational contributions. RNNs with their temporal sequence modeling capabilities are explored for applications where time dependencies are critical. CNNs widely used for their effectiveness in learning spatial hierarchies are highlighted for their transformative role in audio classification. Additionally, hybrid models that combine the strengths of multiple architectures such as CNN-RNN and CNN-SVM, are discussed for their ability to capture both spatial and temporal features. The survey critically examines the strengths and limitations of each approach, compares their performance on various datasets and outlines current challenges and future directions in the field.

articleTitle: Solar Power Generation in Electric Vehicle for Sustainable Transportation: A Case Study
abstract: Charging and range are two of the most common problems with electric vehicles (EVs). It is not a practical option to charge electric vehicles via the grid. Unlike conventional EVs, this article considered solar panels mounted on top of the EVs for charging, named (SIEVs) solar modules integrated EVs. This analysis is based on a case study that takes into account the badvel location in India throughout the year. Battery capacity and SoC during different shading conditions in different seasons are analyzed in this article. Additionally, the analysis also takes into account the advantages of the grid and the increase in its range.

articleTitle: Knee Osteoarthritis Detection Using an Improved CenterNet With Pixel-Wise Voting Scheme
abstract: The primary objective of the project is to identify and diagnose knee osteoarthritis using knee images obtained through X-ray scans. X-ray images are a common and cost-effective modality for examining knee joint health, and the project focuses on leveraging these images for accurate detection of osteoarthritis. Current methods for knee osteoarthritis detection, which rely on image processing techniques, face challenges in terms of accuracy and precision. This technique involves the development of a specialized Center Net,A state-of-the-art object detection architecture. This Center Net is tailored with a pixelwise voting scheme, a, method that allows for the extraction of the features at a granular level. By customizing the Center Net in this way, the project aim to enhance the accuracy and reliability of knee osteoarthritis detection the model incorporates Dense Net 201 as a basic network for future extraction. By utilizing DenseNet201, the model aims to capture the most representative features for knee samples,enhancing the robustness of the feature extraction process.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Food Waste Management System
abstract: In a world where we waste a lot of food, we've come up with a clever system to help manage it better. We use a special sensor (like the ones that detect motion) to know when someone throws food away. This sensor talks to a computer that sends this information to the internet, where it's stored safely. You can check all this information on your phone or computer. It even reminds you when it's time to take out the garbage. This system helps stop bins from overflowing, saves money, and is good for the environment because we waste less food. It's easy to use, follows the rules, and can grow as needed. Plus, it keeps your information safe and learns to be better over time. In short, it's a smart system to help us stop wasting food and make the world a little greener. The IoT-based smart food waste management system, with its ultrasonic sensor technology and real-time monitoring capabilities, offers a simple yet powerful solution to the pervasive problem of food waste. Beyond its environmental benefits, it brings convenience to users' lives with timely reminders to take out the trash and suggestions for using up ingredients. Furthermore, the system's ability to collect and analyze data over time can provide valuable insights into consumption patterns and lead to more efficient supply chains. With scalability, user education opportunities, and the potential to make a global impact, this innovative system represents a promising step toward a more sustainable and resource- conscious future. The IoT-Based Smart Food Waste Management System proposed in this project integrates Arduino microcontroller, ultrasonic sensor, GSM module, and LCD display to revolutionize food waste management processes. The system offers real-time monitoring and notification capabilities to efficiently manage food waste levels in a bin.

articleTitle: Leveraging CNNs for Efficient Classification of Apple Leaf Diseases
abstract: This study investigates the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to classify apple plant diseases based on photographs of their leaves. Apple diseases require effective detection techniques because they represent serious risks to crop output and quality. The study makes use of a dataset of tagged photos of apple leaves, which includes both healthy and diseased leaves from conditions including cedar apple rot and apple scab. Data collection, preprocessing, CNN model architecture creation, and training are all part of the methodology. Several CNN architectures are taken into consideration, including VGG, ResNet, and Inception. The model is trained on a split dataset and its performance is monitored on a validation set to prevent overfitting. Evaluation measures include F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. Findings show that CNNs are good at correctly identifying apple leaf diseases. The study emphasizes how this strategy may be used in apple farming for early disease identification and well-informed decision-making. Suggestions for future research include integrating numerous imaging modalities, real-time field classification, and multi-class categorization for various illness types. This study advances the creation of cutting-edge instruments for managing diseases in apple cultivation, which could enhance crop yields and health.

articleTitle: Visual Sign Detection and Voice Conversion
abstract: People who are deaf & dumb Only their hand gestures and facial expressions are used to comouttmunicate with others. It will be suggested a novel method for dumb individuals called artificial speaking mouth. Some people may effortlessly deduce information from their body language. The Mems Sensor is the foundation of this system. Dumb people claim that every motion has a purpose. A database contains that message. Similarly, every template is obtained from a database. The Mems Sensor is fastened to hand while the template information is fed into MC in real time. The MEMS sensor expands with each action and sends a signal to the every action and notifies the MC of it. The MC generates a voice signal after comparing the motion with the database. The speaker serves as the system’s output. The dumb will use the artificial mouth to speak normally if the database is updated correctly.

articleTitle: Automated Skin Cancer Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Approach for Dermoscopic Image Analysis
abstract: Skin cancer is a serious global health concern, highlighting the necessity of early detection and treatment. A specialized Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model was created to automate the diagnosis of skin cancer in dermoscopic pictures. A diverse collection of skin lesion photos was used to train the model using a pre-trained ResNet50 architecture with custom layers. It scored a test accuracy of 91.5%, precision of 89.3%, recall of 93.2%, and an F1-score of 91.2%. The model’s AUC-ROC value of 0.957 demonstrates its exceptional ability to discriminate between benign and malignant tumors. Comparative analysis showed the proposed CNN outperformed traditional machine learning methods and achieved comparable results to other deep learning approaches. Hyperparameter tuning further improved model performance, with the best configuration achieving 93.2% accuracy. The study also explored techniques for model interpretability to enhance clinical applicability. The findings highlight the effectiveness of CNN-based models in achieving accurate and efficient skin cancer detection. This study supports the advancement of automated diagnostic tools, which can aid in early detection and contribute to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Power Quality Investigation in a Grid Connected Microgrid with PV, Wind, ESS & ANN based MPPT
abstract: This research investigates the critical aspect of power quality in a microgrid interconnected with photovoltaic (PV) panels, wind turbines, and battery storage, utilizing an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) under nonlinear load condition. Various power quality parameters such as Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), voltage regulation during load changes, and response to grid disturbances are analyzed. The ANN-based MPPT algorithm is implemented to optimize power extraction from the PV panels, considering varying environmental conditions and load demands. Simulations are conducted using MATLAB to emulate real-world scenarios and assess the system's performance under dynamic conditions. The results obtained from this research provide valuable insights into enhancing power quality in microgrids integrated with multiple RES, tiling the path to dependable and efficient energy systems with reduced environmental impact.

articleTitle: A Universal Design of Flyback Converter for Isolated Gate Drive Power Supply
abstract: In the field of power electronics, compact design of isolated gate driver circuit is very essential. A Switch-Mode Power Supply (SMPS) having higher power density is very useful solution for the same. This work proposes an overall design of a flyback converter along with design of high-frequency (HF) transformer. Considering contunuous conduction mode (CCM) of operation, the converter is controlled in closed loop using UC3842. The arrangement for UC3842, selection of MOSFET as high-frequency switcing device and magnetics for HF transformer are also proposed. Based on the designed parameters, converter is simulated to check the performance.

articleTitle: Design of Power Converter For Electric Vehicle Application
abstract: This paper represents power converter design and analysis for use in electric vehicle applications. In electric vehicle applications, the primary converter types are DC-DC converters (used to adjust voltage levels within the battery system) and DC-AC inverters, which use various topologies such as buck, boost, and bidirectional (buck-boost) converters, are devices that convert battery DC power to AC power for motors chosen based on whether a higher or lower voltage is required, and the specific power requirements of the vehicle system; essentially, Voltage is increased with "boost" converters and decreased with "buck" converters, with "buck-boost" depending on the application. This paper highlights the design of a battery controller bidirectional converter in an electric vehicle to regulate energy flow, manage the power flow under all circumstances, and match the battery voltage to the motor's rated voltage.

articleTitle: Design of Delay Efficient High Speed Adder Circuit
abstract: In the design of complex processor systems, components are broken down into smaller, manageable parts. These parts include essential circuits such as adders, subtractors, multipliers, and various functional units. The core components of these arithmetic systems are primarily adders. The Arithmetic and Logical Unit (ALU) is a crucial Processing Unit, with its processing speed being a key factor in the overall performance of a CPU. This speed is influenced by the duration required to process data. In the realm of arithmetic operations, adders play a pivotal role on the key route. The quantity of logic levels taken into consideration while evaluating the performance of adders is a critical metric, area, and critical-path latency. It's crucial to enhance speed without compromising power efficiency. Therefore, a design that is both Elevated performance at low power is crucial. This work utilizes the Parallel Prefix Architecture (PPA) to offer a novel approach to solving this problem. For energy-efficient applications and employs the "Hybrid Variable Latency" method to efficiently design adders. The performance of the adder is analyzed using Vivado. This proposed method is significantly faster compared to existing techniques.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Point Tracking of DC Microgrid Using hybrid GA-PSO Optimization Techniques
abstract: Renewable energy sources can provide universal and fast electrical availability. Solar Photovoltaic (PV) systems are unique despite oscillations in output power owing to solar radiation, cell performance, and ambient temperatures. Additionally, implemented modules often convert inefficiently. Thus, maximum power point monitoring is essential to maximize solar energy harvesting and solar system efficiency. The objective of this study is to conduct a comparative analysis of maximum power point tracking using the Horse Herd Optimization (HHO) algorithm, the Flying Squirrel Search Optimization (FSSO) algorithm, and the hybrid Genetic and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm (GA-PSO) approach. During this experiment, Matlab simulation was used to compare the output power to various variable input elements, such as temperature and irradiation. Additionally, the comparative analysis of the algorithm is illustrated through the use of tables and figures.

articleTitle: Wind Energy Conversion Systems (WECS), their uses and recent challenges in Grid- Integration
abstract: The best way to generate electricity is to avoid harmful gases by using renewable energy sources such as wind energy systems and solar energy. In the ecological and sustainable alternative, wind energy is considered as one of the fastest growing electricity or energy sources. The share of renewable energy sources in global energy production is increasing day by day. The demand for electricity is globally growing double as fast as basic energy demand. Modern power system scenarios require reliability and very high quality. Distributed power generation, including wind turbines and solar systems, has become an important source in spreading the awareness of green energy. In this article, we look at the development of various winds power conversion systems (WECS) with their advantages and disadvantages. With the increasing use of electronic energy converters (EPE) based renewable energy sources, new stability issues are changing the dynamics of power systems. This article reviews the most widely used wind power systems as current solutions and design fundamentals of custom applications with its recent challenges in grid- integration.

articleTitle: Automated Mushroom Species Identification and Prediction Using Image Processing and Machine Learning
abstract: Mushroom species distinguishing proof may be a basic assignment in mycology, with noteworthy suggestions for biology, pharmaceutical, and nourishment security. Traditional strategies of distinguishing proof, depending on master information and manual examination, are regularly time- devouring and inclined to human mistake. This venture points to create an, and F1 score. The framework will moreover join a user-friendly instrument that empowers clients to yield photographs and get momentary gauges with respect to the species and edibility of the mushroom. By automating the distinguishing proof handle, this venture points to supply a fast, solid, and available instrument for mycologists, analysts, and the common open. This advancement holds the potential to essentially decrease the chance of mushroom harming, help within the preservation of biodiversity, and back different logical considers in mycology.

articleTitle: Enhancing Advanced Text Classification Algorithms for Topic Modelling in English Literature
abstract: The research explores the enhancement of text classification and topic modeling in English literature through advanced transformer-based algorithms, specifically focusing on models like RoBERTa. Traditional methods such as "{Latent Dirichlet Allocation" (LDA) and "Latent Semantic Analysis" (LSA) have limitations in capturing the complexities of literary texts, which often feature layered meanings and diverse narrative structures. The study proposes leveraging transformers to improve classification accuracy and thematic coherence by utilizing self-attention mechanisms that analyze entire texts rather than relying solely on word frequency. By fine-tuning transformer models for literary analysis, this research aims to effectively discern complex themes and classify texts across various genres and historical contexts. The methodology includes the use of diverse datasets, including Wikipedia, Reuters, and 20-Newsgroups, to ensure robust training and testing of the models. Data preprocessing techniques such as tokenization, stemming, and lemmatization are employed to optimize the text for analysis. The anticipated outcome is a refined transformer-based tool that not only categorizes literature with greater accuracy but also aids scholars in uncovering thematic patterns, thereby enriching literary studies. The findings are expected to bridge the gap between machine learning techniques and the unique demands of literary analysis, ultimately enhancing scholarly research within the humanities. This advancement holds promise for transforming how literature is analyzed and interpreted in academic settings.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Automatic Syntax and Semantic Error Identification in English Writings
abstract: Proficiency in written English is crucial for academic and professional achievement. However, the competency of non-native speakers is an issue in syntax and semantics thus the coherency of their writings may be affected. Current grammar checkers like Grammarly as well as MS Word grammar and spelling checkers are normally able to only scan for simple grammar mishaps, for example, spelling errors and hence fail to flag complicated syntactical and/or semantic inaccuracies. The current research aims at creating a machine learning approach to error identification of syntax and semantic errors in English written work to improve feedback on language concerns. The study proposes a synergistic model that integrates rule-based methods for syntax error detection whereas the semantic error identification is done by large language model (GPT). This integration is designed to overcome the limitations of existing tools, providing a more comprehensive error detection system. The proposed framework has three main stages: (1) rule-based methods for detecting syntax errors, such as tense agreement and subject-verb concord, (2) a deep learning model (GPT) for identifying semantic errors related to word choice and context, and (3) integration of results to produce a detailed, categorized error report. These results indicate high performance with 98% of accuracy which means that the model helped to perform more accurate evaluation and revealed slightly increased clarity and coherence of the evaluated samples. This hybrid model provides a rich solution for identifying syntax and semantic errors and improving the quality of comments particularly to the non-English speaking students. This framework may be useful for learners in academic contexts to help those learning English gain greater abilities.

articleTitle: Employing Deep Learning to Create Speech Recognition Systems for Accented English
abstract: This research proposes a novel approach for developing an accented English speech recognition system using a deep learning model optimized by the African Buffalo Optimization (ABO) algorithm. Accented English speech recognition poses unique challenges, as variations in pronunciation and intonation across accents can significantly impact recognition accuracy. To address these challenges, the proposed model utilizes an ABO-LSTM framework, which combines the long short-term memory network’s capability to capture long-term dependencies with the ABO algorithm's strength in optimizing model parameters for enhanced accuracy. The methodology begins with data collection from a publicly available dataset, capturing English speech samples from speakers of various accents, including English, French, German, Italian, UK, and US. Audio preprocessing involves noise reduction through band-pass filtering to improve feature quality. Key speech characteristics are then extracted using Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC), which emulate human auditory perception and serve as input features for the model. The ABO algorithm optimizes the LSTM network by adjusting parameters such as learning rate, depth, and hidden units to minimize error rates. The results, demonstrated through confusion matrices and accuracy metrics, show significant improvement in accent classification accuracy of 95.4%, with the model successfully differentiating accents and handling linguistic variations in diverse contexts. This study contributes to speech recognition research by introducing a bio-inspired optimization method tailored for accented speech, with potential applications in cross-cultural communication, language learning, and automated transcription systems. The findings suggest that ABO-optimized LSTMs can effectively address accented speech recognition challenges, paving the way for more inclusive and adaptive speech recognition technologies.

articleTitle: Implementation Of 4×4 Braun Multiplier Using Hybrid Full Adder
abstract: The Braun Multiplier, a form of parallel multiplier, provides a regular and simple structure but faces similar challenges in terms of power, area, and speed. This project aims to design and implement a Braun Multiplier optimized with a hybrid full adder to address these limitations. The hybrid full Adder combines multiple logic styles, such as CMOS and Transmission gate logic, to achieve a balance between power efficiency, speed, and area reduction. By replacing this hybrid full adder, the overall performance will be increase. The design is executed by using Cadence Virtuoso tool, which is a leading platform in VLSI design and simulation. The project includes the schematic design of Braun Multiplier, simulation to validate functional correction and performance. In conclusion, the design shows a reduction in power, propagation delay and high speed, by integrating a hybrid full adder into the Braun Multiplier which results in more efficient design, offering potential for use in advanced digital systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mobility in Autonomous Robotics with a Four-Wheel and Four-Steering System Controlled Remotely via Ubuntu
abstract: A Novel approach to building and controlling a four-wheel, four-drive, and four-steering (4W4D4S) robotic system is presented in this research. This system allows for enhanced mobility and navigation by allowing each wheel to spin up to 180 degrees independently. The Ubuntu command prompt is used to remotely operate the system, making it accessible and controllable from virtually anywhere with network connectivity. The project addresses crucial needs for real-time navigation and multi-terrain adaptability in autonomous systems via using Linux-based control systems for reliability as well as versatility in command execution. Effective control responsiveness is demonstrated by experimental results, indicating the system's potential for use in complicated terrains, logistics, and agriculture. Improved operational agility provided by the proposed 4W4D4S system provides the way for better autonomous mobility solutions in various environments. The wheels of the bot is capable of moving zero degree, 45 degrees, 90 degrees, and 180 degrees. If precision is needed then it also capable of moving any angle between 0-180 degrees. The camera that is a vision system integrated into the controller, makes it possible to communicate through the vision system. The camera vision is available with in the command prompt whenever node is run in the terminal.

articleTitle: Advances in Offshore Wind Turbine Systems: A Technical Review
abstract: In this paper, offshore wind energy has been discussed in brief with their importance as compare to other renewable energy sources. Harnessing of the wind offshore become an important opportunity for sustainable renewable energy source. Therefore, industries and researchers are working in this area. Offshore wind energy is more potent and constant in offshore locations due to the absence of impediments. To effectively conventional energy sources, it's crucial to understand the physics behind the movement of offshore wind turbines, along with various design strategies and analytical methods. This paper reviews the latest progress in floating offshore wind turbine technology, highlighting new designs, challenges, and future opportunities. It summarizes current research and innovations while discussing ongoing issues and next steps for the industry.

articleTitle: Improving Power Grid Frequency Stability in Isolated Networks by Implementing the Artificial Electric Field Algorithm with FESS and BESS
abstract: This study devoted to enhancing frequency deviation regulation in an isolated power system. The modelling configuration integrates generation sources like wind turbines, solar panels, fuel cells, and diesel generators, supported by energy storage technology. To address load fluctuation issues, this study applied the artificial electric field algorithm (AEFA). The efficacy of this method is evaluated in scenarios with uncertainties such as varying wind speed, fluctuating load demands, and inconsistent sunlight. Simulation study indicate that, combined with FESS and BESS, the AEFA-based controller notably diminishes variations, signifying stability.

articleTitle: Soft Computing Techniques Based MPPT for Solar Photovoltaic System
abstract: The focus of this study is on the efficient implementation of a simulation model design for a 100 KW photovoltaic (PV) system connected to a three-phase grid. The design consists of a single-string system, a DC-DC converter, a DC-AC converter, and two power-handling stages. The maximum power output was obtained using a unique hybrid ant lion optimization-cuckoo search (ALO-CS) maximum power point tracking(MPPT) method. The LC filter’s function is to connect the inverter’s output to the grid. According to the solid-state electronics in both converters’ inherent switching capabilities, this filter efficiently filters out the harmonics in the current as desired. With the support of the hybrid ALO-CS optimization technique, the power tracking is improved to 92.3 KW and harmonics has been reduced to 0.43% by using the current control technique in the voltage source converter. The hybrid approach used in this study is more efficient than individual algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation and hardware implementation of MPPT algorithms for smart street lighting powered by solar energy
abstract: The abundance of solar energy in nature is well known and the voltaic cell using the solar photon is the means to convert this to white coal called electricity. A solar cell gives direct current just like batteries. Maximum MPPT is a broadly-used control scheme that varies the operating point to exploit the extreme total of power available from a photovoltaic module’s solar cell. The application of numerous MPPT algorithms in a PV system is discussed in this paper. Normally a step-up converter is implemented to operate an MPPT. The core of the MPPT concept's technology is the DC-DC converter's duty ratio alternation. A representative of the Photo Voltaic cell module has been designed using a simulation platform by implementing various MPPT Techniques and their results have been reviewed.

articleTitle: Reduction of Transformer Linear Section Model Using a Novel Mixed Method
abstract: Because of their enormous dimensions, Power System modules are challenging and complex to examine in their original form. This necessitates a suitable technique to simplify the analysis of the higher order model by reducing it to its lower representation. As a result, the Reduced Order Model (ROM) was developed, producing results that are roughly equivalent to the original model. There are a number of simple techniques in the literature, but each has its own drawbacks and difficulties. In order to provide a novel hybrid technique for determining the ROM of power system modules, this research suggests combining two approaches. This method uses the Direct Truncation (DT) to obtain the denominator polynomial and the Routh Stability Array (RSA) to obtain the numerator polynomial of the ROM. This novel technique is demonstrated in Transformer Linear Section Model (TLSM) to reduce the system in second order. The original higher order model and the resulting lower order model's time and frequency responses are used to evaluate the suggested approach. Additionally, validations are carried out by computing several performance indices and comparing them with the other methods already in use. In order to create and analyze an appropriate order reduction methodology for power systems modules with a reduction in settling time, the suggested RSA-DT method provides the approximate tracking. The rise time obtained for ROM of TLSM is 0.748s while the settling time is 1.13s. The steady state value is seen tracing the original system at 0.156.

articleTitle: ZSI, Q-ZSI and SL-QZSI - A Comparative Performance Analysis
abstract: In recent scenario, high power drive requires inverter for variable voltage voltage/frequency operation. For the conventional inverter, DC voltage is to be kept at higher level to obtain desired rated voltage as per applications. In order to get around this problem, Z-Source Inverter can increase the DC voltage in a single stage, which will allow requirement for the drive to be fulfilled. In this proposed work, different topologies of ZSI are investigated to boost the DC voltage. A comparative study is carried out pertaining to different performance parameters between Z-Source Inverter (ZSI), Quasi Z-Source Inverter (QZSI) and Switched Inductor Quasi Z-Source Inverter (SL-QZSI) through simulink environment. Also selection of inductors and capacitors with respect to their current and voltage stress are also estimated to find a suitable solution for high power drive applications.

articleTitle: Design of Filter on AC Side for Grid Connected Solar Powered Inverter for EV Applications
abstract: In the present day, green energy utilization has been increased with the increase in the demerits of conventional energy resources. However, obtaining a pure output from the former is a significant challenge. One such issue is the presence of harmonics in the power electronic based converter, which is the bridge coupling between solar photovoltaic systems and the utility grid. Apart from this there is a limit on current harmonic magnitude corresponding to the frequency of switching. Thus, necessitates the need of filter towards the AC side of inverter connected to the grid. This effectively removes the harmonic content of grid current and replaces it with a smooth sinusoidal waveform. Although there are different types of filters available there are various drawbacks associated with them.thus degrading their usage. Thus a filter need to be designed which provides desired attenuation for the harmonics corresponding to the switching frequency and creates a low impedance path for the fundamental component. In view of this in order to enhace the ripple free output an LCL type filter is modeled and is compared with the already existing topologies such as L, LC type filters in terms of their control parameters using Bode plot. More over detailed analysis is carried out on LCL filter coupled to a 1-0 solar inverter connected to the grid. The filter designed is capable of reducing the ripple and the frequency and amplitude are reduced to levels that meet the harmonic limits to a low value according to IEEE standards. Thus increasing its importance for the usage in high frequency switching operations, Grid-Connected Inverters for Renewable Energy Systems, EV Chargers, Motor Drive Systems etc.

Author Keywords: solar powered inverter connected to the grid

articleTitle: Interpretation of model establishment for Eccentricity in Extruded High Voltage Cables
abstract: Today’s underground high voltage transmission network needs great importance to power sectors, electrical utilities, and various industrial users. The consistent operation of these cables depends on their long lifespan and trouble-free performance, which is essential for maintaining a reliable and efficient power supply. But the increasing asset age of the cable system and precise defect causes more failures. First, the examination of two-dimensional analysis between concentric core and led to the establishment of the cable eccentricity of 2mm, 4mm and 6mm; second, the primary performance and its influencing factors were examined. As a result, the portion of the power cable near the eccentricity point has higher stress could deteriorate earlier compared to the other axial directions of cable.

articleTitle: Optimizing PMU Placement By Using Modified Simulated Annealing Method
abstract: This paper introduces a Modified Simulated Annealing technique for the optimal placement of PMUs for the observability of interconnected electrical networks. For solving optimization problems in the power system like unit commitment, economic dispatch, and load scheduling in power system optimization simulated Annealing (SA) is used to give the optimum solution to the problems. Compared to the basic SA method, the Modified simulated annealing method improves by optimization processes and optimum PMU placement solution. A modified two-stage technique finding procedure to optimize. A variety of resource limitations and effectiveness are confirmed with a suggested issue. They are evaluated, enhanced, and assessed under identical conditions, and the reasons for obtaining enhancements are succinctly clarified. The suggested approach has been evaluated on the IEEE 14-bus, IEEE 30-bus, 39-bus, IEEE 57-bus, and IEEE 118-bus.

articleTitle: Performance and Power Analysis of Various Complements on the FPGA Board
abstract: In light of the increased attention paid to the development of energy-efficient electronics and computing systems, this paper focuses on the design and implementation of digital circuits that are 1s, 2s, 9s, and 10s complements on the Kintex FPGA board. The emphasis is given to evaluating power consumption and thermal performance so that low-energy digital systems can be developed. The measured power consumption of the circuitry was 1.074W for 1’s complement, 1.594W for 2’s complement, 1.499W for 9’s complement, and 1.665W for 10’s complement hence showing a variation in power with reason analysis. Also in addition to power analysis, temperature performance was assessed presenting thermal management of temperatures 58°C, 72.7°C, 72.4°C and 72.1°C for each of the complements respectively. These results indicate that implementation of digital hardware design using Kintex FPGA not only consumes less power but also runs cool. This helps meet the green communication standards which advocate for a reduction in energy use without compromising performance in the hardware design. Such implementations on FPGA turn out to be good alternatives for systems where power is of great concern, thus making the Kintex board ideal for low-power digital applications that require sustainability.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Classification and Detection of Brain Tumour for Real-Time Medical Applications
abstract: Automated defect detection in medical imaging, particularly the detection and classification of brain tumor, has made researchers to show interest in this area of research. The complexity and variability of brain tumors make manual identification challenging. MRI scans, however, offer valuable data for accurate diagnosis. Machine learning algorithms present a promising approach to address these challenges, as they can learn from large datasets of MRI images. Using machine algorithms like CNN, SVM and ResNet50 will be performing the training, testing and validation. It is considered a multi-class dataset consisting of no tumor, pituitary, meningioma, and glioma tumors. An algorithm is proposed that contains large dataset where results demonstrate that CNN has 90% validation accuracy and 99% training accuracy also with 90% of weighted-average f1-score. The main purpose is that to compare performance analysis in between CNN, SVM and ResNet50 and to achieve greater accuracy using large dataset by performing CNN model.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Implementation of 1's and 2's Complement on Kintex Board: Evaluating Power and Thermal Management
abstract: As the demand for energy-efficient digital systems develops, circuits that limit power consumption and facilitate green communication are becoming increasingly crucial to design. This study focuses on designing and implementing 1's and 2's complement arithmetic circuits on the Kintex FPGA board, emphasizing thermal efficiency and energy economy. The entire power usage of the 1's complement circuit is 1.074W, but the 2's complement circuit needs 1.594W. Additionally, the thermal study showed that the complement circuits of 1s and 2s complement have heat margins of 58°C and 72.7°C, respectively. These results indicate how the Kintex FPGA may be leveraged as an energy-efficient platform for digital design that balances hardware performance and power consumption, thereby furthering the objectives of green communication.

articleTitle: E-Buddy for Rescue Child Labour
abstract: Ebuddy is a ground breaking platform dedicated to rescuing and rehabilitating child laboures. By leveraging advanced technology, this initiative effectively connects with at-risk children, providing them with crucial education and support services. With a mission to break the vicious cycle of poverty and exploitation, Ebuddy collaborates with local communities and organizations to raise awareness about child labor and advocate for policies that safeguard children's rights. This platform offers comprehensive support services aimed at addressing the children's physical, emotional, and psychological well-being. By providing counseling, rehabilitation, and necessary medical assistance, Ebuddy empowers children to leave their past behind and embrace a better future.

articleTitle: Realistic Lip Synchronization Using Deep Learning Techniques for Speech Generation
abstract: In this paper a thorough approach is provided to address the problem to bridge language gaps for educational purposes and support the elderly in overcoming language barriers. The system leverages advanced image processing, text extraction, translation, and text-to-speech synthesis to convert textual information from images, screens, or printed materials into synchronized audio output. Utilizing an approach inspired by Wave2Lip synchronization, the system achieves seamless alignment of the translated audio with the original video content. This multi-stage processing pipeline employs techniques such as adaptive thresholding, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), machine translation, and natural language processing to ensure accurate and efficient language conversion. The proposed methodology offers an innovative tool for creating an inclusive and accessible learning environment, enabling realtime language translation and enhancing comprehension, particularly for older adults who may find it difficult to grasp foreign languages. This approach ultimately contributes to breaking down linguistic barriers, fostering cross-cultural understanding, and promoting educational accessibility for diverse populations.

articleTitle: Modelling of Cyber Intrusion in Active Distribution Grid Equipped with DVR
abstract: The distribution grid around the globe is evolving with higher penetration of distributed generation having renewable sources of energy as a major component, and IEDs, PMUs that communicate and exchange monitoring and control information through cyberinfrastructure. The bi-directional energy flow in distribution systems might aid the existing power quality issues of voltage sag, swell, flicker, and harmonics. The custom power devices used to tackle these disturbances could be subjected to cyber-attacks. The challenges of cyber-attacks are evident and need to be investigated as several breaches in the power sector have been witnessed across the globe. The cyber intrusions could lead a system into catastrophic blackout or cause economic/equipment damage. This paper presents a framework for modelling the cyber intrusion on active distribution grids equipped with dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) for mitigation of disturbances like voltage sag and swell. The standard IEEE 5 bus test system has been developed in MATLAB with a DVR for mitigating the voltage sag and swell.

articleTitle: CVR Implementation and VVO Control in Smart Distribution Systems: A Literature Survey
abstract: This study examines the implementation of Conservation Voltage Reduction (CVR) technology in an intelligent energy distribution network. It also investigates the evaluation of CVR using an Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) that integrates a Voltage Var Optimization (VVO) control strategy. The primary goal of this approach is to minimize active power losses in the distribution network while enhancing the performance of On-Load Tap Changers (OLTC), Automatic Voltage Regulators (AVR), and capacitor banks. This research aims to provide valuable insights for researchers and power engineers regarding CVR technology and its applications in distribution systems. Additionally, the study highlights the potential benefits of CVR in improving energy efficiency and reducing overall power consumption. The findings can contribute to the development of more sustainable and cost-effective power distribution strategies.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Boost-Buck Converters under Variable Load Conditions
abstract: An electric vehicle (EV) battery can be considered as a variable load in the context of a boost-buck converter due to its varying load conditions. These variations arise from several factors: the state of charge (SoC) as the battery charges and discharges, different driving scenarios (acceleration, cruising, deceleration) demanding varying power levels, auxiliary loads from systems like climate control, lighting, and infotainment, and dynamic load conditions during regenerative braking. While boost-buck converters are well-explored in literature, this paper introduces some methodologies for evaluating their performance specifically in EV applications. The converter's response to dynamic load changes typical of EV batteries is explored and various aspects such as the detailed impact of load resistance variations on input current and overall efficiency are highlighted. Simulation results are validated with experimental results, demonstrating the practical implications of the outcomes.

articleTitle: Lane Detection on Structured Roads using Ternaus-Net Architecture
abstract: Lane detection is considered one of the essential elements that an autonomous driving system must provide accurate navigation over roads to ensure the safety of vehicles. Current lane detection techniques are still not good enough, and they cannot recognize lanes in structured and semi-structured environments, especially when applied in real-world driving environments. This paper introduces a U-Net-based architecture named TernausNet, which adopts an encoder-decoder based on the encoder-decoder version of VGG16, particularly fine-tuned for accuracy in segmentation tasks. This architecture is part of a deep-learning approach toward lane detection. TuSimple is a quite popular benchmark for lane detection, which covers all sorts of road conditions from around the world. The model is trained and assessed using this dataset. It can demonstrate that even in challenging circumstances, like faded lane lines, shadows, and occlusions, the results are dependable and accurate in identifying lane markings.

articleTitle: Enhancing Electric Vehicle Energy Conservation through ML Algorithms
abstract: A novel approach has been considered for energy consumption and how it can be optimized for industries utilizing microgrids powered by renewable energy sources (RES). The targeted industry includes a microgrid, an integrated system with photovoltaic cells (PV), electric vehicles (EV), charging stations, and additional renewable energy generation methods. The main goal of the application created is to provide predictive analysis on energy generation, consumption, and availability by utilizing historical and real-time inputs. The system will be providing the EV users with automatic notifications regarding the optimal period to charge the EV. By constant monitoring of the EV user battery levels, timely alerts can be delivered to users on charging their vehicle. In addition, the system also facilitates bidirectional energy flow (BEF), a process that includes vehicle-to-grid (V2G) and grid-to-vehicle (G2V) between EVs and microgrids, allowing EVs to return energy back to the grid during low-generation periods of renewable energy. This approach will contribute to maintaining grid stability, reducing load consumption costs, and enhancing energy resilience within the industry. Overall, this system represents a significant contribution to sustainable energy management by ensuring efficient utilization of renewable energy resources and improving industrial energy autonomy.

articleTitle: Advanced Financial Portfolio Management Using a Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework
abstract: The integration of advanced machine learning techniques, particularly deep reinforcement learning (DRL), in financial portfolio management has gained significant attention for its potential to optimize trading strategies. This paper introduces a comprehensive methodology for developing a DRL-based framework aimed at enhancing investment decision-making and overall portfolio performance. Using a robust dataset from Kaggle that includes historical price data, trading volumes, and technical indicators, the proposed approach addresses the complexities of trading in volatile markets. Key stages of the methodology include data preprocessing, feature engineering, environment setup, and the development of a DRL agent, followed by rigorous back testing and evaluation against traditional portfolio management techniques. The DRL agent, implemented in Python using prominent machine learning libraries, achieved an impressive accuracy of 98%, demonstrating its effectiveness in predicting profitable trades while managing risk. Back testing results show substantial improvements in portfolio returns compared to conventional methods, highlighting the framework's potential for real-world trading applications. This research not only contributes to the existing literature on financial machine learning but also offers practical insights for practitioners interested in applying advanced methodologies in trading operations. By combining cutting-edge algorithms with real-time market data, the framework aims to enhance the efficiency and robustness of financial portfolio management.

articleTitle: Optimizing Environment Sustainability: AI-Driven Supply Chain Impact with Ensemble & Deep Reinforcement Learning (Aligned with SDG 9, 12, 13, and 17)
abstract: In an era of increasing environmental awareness, the current study explores the transformative impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on optimizing supply chains for sustainability, aligning with UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 9, 12, 13, and 17. We investigate various AI techniques, including Linear Regression, Gradient Boosting, Support Vector Regression (SVR), Random Forest, XGBoost, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The current analysis demonstrates how these methods enhance decision-making, predictive analytics, and adaptive optimization to reduce resource consumption, emissions, and waste. Through case studies and frameworks, we provide a strategic pathway for utilizing these AI models to predict and achieve sustainability targets in supply chain management, supporting innovation, responsible consumption, climate action, and global partnerships.

articleTitle: Farming 4.0: Integrating Technology for Smart Agriculture
abstract: The Hydro Growth system presents an innovative approach to hydroponic farming, integrating Arduino microcontroller technology, mobile application, and solar panel power sources. In regions facing water scarcity, such as arid areas, this system offers a sustainable solution by utilizing dehumidifiers as a fresh water source for hydroponics, powered by solar panels. This study aims to design and develop a hydroponics application that monitors water quality parameters, including pH, TDS, and temperature, providing accurate management of hydroponic environments. Employing a qualitative and experimental research design, an Iterative Waterfall model is utilized for system development, ensuring alignment with user and business requirements. Arduino microcontroller capabilities facilitate hardware and software integration, while sensors such as pH, TDS, and temperature sensors, along with GSM and temperature sensors, enhance system functionality. Development of the mobile application is achieved through Android Studio, JAVA, Node.js, and other relevant technologies, ensuring a robust and secure platform for user interaction. Evaluation of the Hydro Growth system demonstrates its scalability and intelligence in providing effective hydroponic farming management. Regional agricultural experts consistently rate the system as effective, reinforcing its potential as an innovative tool for sustainable agriculture. Additionally, hydroponically grown food is recognized for its nutritional benefits over soil-based farming methods. The system continuously monitors water quality and sends SMS notifications to users, not only alerting them to abnormalities but also providing guidance on corrective actions, such as adding organic chemicals, to maintain optimal growing conditions.

articleTitle: Predicting the Maximum Temperature at Two Meters Above Earth's Surface Using CNN-LSTM Attention Mechanism
abstract: Climate monitoring, energy management, and agriculture are just a few of the sectors that depend on accurate temperature forecasts. By integrating a CNN and LSTM with an attention mechanism, this study seeks to develop a more precise temperature forecasting model. Using meteorological data gathered from NASA's Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) platform, the suggested model is intended to forecast the maximum temperature at two meters above Earth's surface. Benchmarks for comparison are established time series forecasting models like ARIMA and FB Prophet. The attention mechanism helps the CNN-LSTM model better focus on significant time steps. CNN layers are used to capture spatial patterns in the data, and LSTM layers are used to characterize temporal dependencies. A number of metrics, including RMSE, MAE, RRSE, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, are used to assess the models' performance. As evidenced by the much reduced RMSE (1.61) and higher R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (0.92), the CNN-LSTM with attention mechanism performs better than traditional models in temperature prediction, according to the results. As compared to conventional methods, the study finds that deep learning models—especially CNN-LSTM with attention—offer a more reliable and accurate method for predicting temperature. This suggests new directions for future research in real-time forecasting, model optimization, and the incorporation of other environmental variables.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Rainfall Prediction for Coastal Cities: A Case Study of Chennai
abstract: Accurate weather prediction plays a crucial role in reducing risks linked to extreme weather events, especially for coastal cities like Chennai, which are highly susceptible to monsoons, cyclones, and urban flooding. Traditional weather forecasting models, although useful, often struggle to account for the non-linear and dynamic nature of local atmospheric conditions. This research examines the machine learning applications and methodologies for prediction and improve accuracy for Chennai. Leveraging extensive historical meteorological data, satellite observations, and real-time atmospheric parameters, we apply Several ML models, encompassing weather factors like temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and humidity are forecast. Our research compares the model performance against traditional methods, such as numerical weather prediction (NWP) models, in short- to medium-term forecasting. Results indicate that ML models not only achieve higher precision but also demonstrate better adaptability to local climatic peculiarities, improving lead time for critical weather events. Additionally, this study examines the integration of ML models with real-time data streams to create adaptive, self-learning systems for continuous improvement of weather forecasts.

articleTitle: Advancing Climate Change Forecasting: LSTM-based Earth Surface Temperature Prediction Across 88 Global Cities
abstract: Global climate change, manifested through increasing wild fires, rising sea levels, and species extinction, primarily stems from rising global temperatures. Hence proposed a study on predicting Earth surface temperatures using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The proposed model provided a powerful tool for temperature forecasting, crucial for potentially saving lives and preserving vegetation. The LSTM model demonstrated superior predictive capabilities for temperature forecasting when compared to the Decision Tree Regression approach. This study contributes significantly to climate modeling knowledge, providing a valuable resource for scientists and policymakers. The global warming doesn’t manifest uniformly, the proposed research utilizes a comprehensive dataset spanning 25 years (1995-2020) across 88 global cities. According to the suggested LSTM, there was 99 percent of validity which can be interpreted from these precautions taken in the stock analysis. 18% accuracy with low error rates (RMSE: 3. 76 K, Mean Absolute Error: 2. 971 K, Mean Absolute Percentage Error: 5. 676. The proposed work helps to improve climate predictions and, thus, aids decision-making of mitigation and adaptation to climate change.

articleTitle: Extensive Signal Integrity Analysis for High-Speed Printed Circuit Boards in Advanced IoT Applications
abstract: The ever-increasing demand for higher data transfer rates and faster electronic devices, the signal integrity of Printed Circuit Board has turn into a critical aspect in ensuring reliable and efficient communication within electronic systems. The analysis begins with an exploration of the fundamental principles governing signal integrity, including transmission line theory, impedance matching, and signal degradation mechanisms. Special emphasis is placed on the impact of factors such as trace impedance, crosstalk, and electromagnetic interference (EMI) on signal quality in high-speed digital and mixed-signal environments. Advanced simulation techniques and modelling tools are employed to assess the behaviour of signals as they propagate through complex PCB layouts. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the signal integrity challenges associated with high-speed PCBs, offering a systematic analysis of key factors influencing signal integrity and proposing effective mitigation strategies. The paper discusses the importance of accurate modelling in predicting signal integrity issues early in the design phase, facilitating the identification of potential problems and enabling timely adjustments to improve overall performance

articleTitle: Advancements in Energy Harvesting Technologies with a Focus on Solar Energy Solutions
abstract: Energy harvesting technologies have emerged as vital tools for addressing the growing global energy demand by converting ambient energy into electrical power. This paper provides a comprehensive review of recent developments across various energy harvesting methods, including piezoelectric, thermoelectric, electromagnetic, solar, and hybrid systems. Key advancements in material science, device innovation, and system integration are discussed, which enhance the efficiency and scalability of these technologies. Additionally, challenges such as energy storage, material limitations, and integration with current infrastructure are explored. This review also highlights future directions, particularly focusing on next-generation technology like bio-harvesting systems, which promise to revolutionize sustainable energy solutions. Applications of these systems span across sectors such as wearable electronics, industrial monitoring, and renewable energy, contributing to the development of low-power, self-sustaining devices.

articleTitle: A Novel Blockchain based Security paradigm for sustainable supply chain Majestics and Logistics
abstract: This Introduced in 1991, Blockchain gained prominence in 2008 with bitcoin, marking a revolution in decentralized digital transactions. It works as a decentralized ledger, enabling secure, transparent, and immutable data storage across various applications, overtime the usage of blockchain has expanded to supply chain management, finance, healthcare and more. Blockchain faces challenges in Supply Chain Management applications, like high cost due to decentralization, lack of transparency and inefficient inventory, with this the unidirectional nature of transactions complicates returns, and security risks such as cyber-attacks. This paper proposes utilizing blockchain technology to address supply chain management challenges by decentralizing infrastructure, enhancing effulgence, and enabling traceability. It further suggests tamper- resistant tracking systems and a decentralized trust layer to improve data security, enable reduction of cost.

articleTitle: Design of Self-Calibration Comparator Using CMOS Technology
abstract: In precision measurement systems, comparators play a crucial role in ensuring accurate and reliable operation. Traditional comparators often require frequent calibration to maintain their accuracy, which can be costly and time-consuming. To address this challenge, the concept of a self-calibration comparator has emerged as a solution. This paper presents the design and implementation of a self-calibration comparator that integrates calibration functionality within the comparator circuitry itself. The key innovation lies in the inclusion of built-in reference standards and feedback mechanisms that continuously monitor and adjust the comparator's performance. The design focuses on achieving high accuracy and stability over extended periods without the need for external calibration interventions. Simulations were performed using Cadence Virtuoso in a 90nm CMOS process to evaluate key performance metrics such as input offset voltage, power dissipation, and slew rate. The results show that the self-calibration comparator significantly outperforms conventional comparators, reducing the input offset voltage from 300.1mV to 20mV. Additionally, it demonstrates a fast response time with a slew rate of 3.2V/ns and consumes 10mW of dynamic power. While the power consumption is higher than in traditional designs, the accuracy and reliability gains make the self-calibration comparator highly suitable for high-precision applications, such as industrial metrology and scientific instrumentation. From this one can conclude that, self-calibration comparator represents a significant advancement in comparator design, offering improved accuracy, reduced calibration requirements, and enhanced reliability for critical measurement applications.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Dynamic Pricing in Healthcare: A Predictive Approach
abstract: Hospitals may modify service charges based on availability, demand, location, time of day, and resource usage by employing a method called "dynamic pricing." This effort proposes the introduction of a dynamic pricing model to address the significant capital expenses associated with providing medical services, including those related to infrastructure and expensive medical equipment. It implements machine learning techniques, in the forms of Decision Tree Regressor with changes made according to dynamics in the markets and to choices of customers. Dynamic pricing increases accessibility, hence results in customer satisfaction by maximizing operational efficiency by the transfer of loads between fixed peak hours and off-peak hours along with planning prices according to distinct needs and conditions. Such policies enhance the brand value of the hospital and market visibility because resource allocation becomes efficient through customized and competitive pricing strategy.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT) from the Viewpoint of Energy Efficiency and Security: A Review
abstract: The availability of repetitively sprouting smart devices used in many different technical areas has caused the internet of things energy absorption to grow quickly in current smart devices. Evidence and message technology has cutting-edge intensely. This results in creation of smart gadgets, communication technologies, and various commercial and noncommercial tasks. The main objective of this survey paper is to identify the energy efficiency and security in smart devices or IoT devices. A methodical IoT ecology is therefore proposed, encompassing the diverse IoT components that lack compatibility and energy efficiency. In this review bids an immediate of numerous strategies for dealing with the problem of energy efficiency in IoT. Initially, a feasible review is done to recognize the crucial role of energy efficiency, confidentiality, and security in smart devices and IoT system. A methodical IoT ecology is therefore proposed, encompassing the diverse IoT components that lack compatibility and energy efficiency. In this review submissions an immediate of numerous strategies for dealing with the problem of energy efficiency, confidentiality, and security in IoT system. In its discussion, the study focuses on various factor and smart component IoT devices that consume battery very fast. A qualified analysis and survey summary are also provided that, research has not yet fully clarified the fundamental factors that contribute to heterogeneity and power absorption at the industrial and technical tiers. Based on this, found issues with technical combination. Important parameters have been considered which includes power consumption, scalability, fog data, and focus on to diminishes the smashes, retransmission upstairs, and vitality absorption in an IoT forthcoming net has been covered in our in-depth study.

articleTitle: Real-Time Detection of Malicious URLs by Utilizing Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: It comprises several approaches in both machine learning and deep learning for detecting malicious URL addresses and phishing attacks. Major approaches compared in the field include SVM, CNN, and Random Forest; however, it is seen that most of these processes yield enhanced accuracy and efficiency of classification with Random Forest. Innovation methods including N-Gram algorithms, hybrid gram techniques, tokenization, and vectorization are checked for improvement of the accuracy of detection of malicious URL addresses and phishing attacks based on different datasets. Among these, BERT and LSTMs have been exploited to achieve better real-time detection along with Conditional GANs. Further studies indicates that this process has minimized feature selection issues and hence improved the accuracy and speed of the model. These studies emphasize that further work in this area will be significant in terms of more integration of larger datasets and hybrid models for enhancing its measures of cybersecurity.

articleTitle: From Data to Defense: A Deep Learning Approach to Automated Wildlife Monitoring and Anti-Poaching Efforts
abstract: Biodiversity has been put in great danger due to the threats of illegal hunting, which endangers many life forms and disrupts ecological balance. The World Wildlife Fund reports that extinction threatens nearly 10000 species every year. The existing methods of monitoring have their merits but will crumble under the size of the wildlife preservation areas and the stealthy operations involved in poaching activities. This project seeks to overcome these problems using state-of-the-art machine-learning techniques such as incorporating YOLOv10 for object detection in real-time and Convolutional Autoencoder (CAE) for the purpose of anomaly detection. We present a new dataset, WLD-72, which consists of 14,400 images from 72 classes, which was developed to train models for wildlife recognition and aggressive human behavior targeted at hiding poaching activities. The system is capable of providing real-time surveillance, high accuracy, and effective anti-poaching deployment which all serve the course of conserving wildlife worldwide. Furthermore, it presents a compromise that can be adopted to different environmental types, thus making it very important in the fight against loss of biological diversity.

articleTitle: Solar and Wind based Wireless Power Transmission for Electric Vehicles
abstract: The transition towards sustainable energy solutions has become imperative in combating environmental degradation and reducing dependency on fossil fuels. As part of this shift, electric vehicles (EVs) have gained traction as a promising alternative to internal combustion engine vehicles. However, the widespread adoption of EVs necessitates addressing challenges such as limited battery range and the availability of charging infrastructure. This paper proposes a novel approach to address these challenges through the integration of solar and wind-based wireless power transmission systems for EVs. By harnessing renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind power, and employing wireless power transmission technology, this system aims to provide continuous and eco-friendly charging solutions for EVs. The proposed system comprises solar panels and wind turbines strategically placed along roadways or within urban environments. These renewable energy sources generate electricity, which is then converted and transmitted wirelessly to EVs via inductive power transfer technology. This eliminates the need for physical charging stations and enables seamless charging while vehicles are in motion. Key advantages of this system include increased energy efficiency, reduced greenhouse gas emissions, and enhanced convenience for EV users. Moreover, the integration of solar and wind power ensures reliability and availability of energy resources regardless of weather conditions. Through simulations and feasibility studies, this paper demonstrates the viability and potential benefits of implementing solar and wind-based wireless power transmission for EVs. Additionally, considerations regarding system design, scalability, and economic feasibility are discussed to facilitate the practical implementation of this innovative solution. Overall, the proposed system represents a significant step towards sustainable transportation infrastructure, offering a promising pathway to realize the widespread adoption of electric vehicles while reducing the environmental footprint of the transportation sector.

articleTitle: Recent Developments in Wind Energy Systems
abstract: Wind has significant potential with recent innovation in wind energy systems (WECs), to offer an environmentally friendly solution to our ever-growing energy demands. As nations worldwide strive to widely deploy this renewable energy source, research and new innovations from different communities work to develop new technologies to overcome the wind’s inherent shortcoming– intermittency. This article represents significant innovations in wind energy production, such as improvements in turbine design, cost reduction methods in wind energy systems and incorporation of digital & smart technologies, to enhance efficiency and broaden the deployment opportunities. Further work towards improving wind energy harvesting includes advanced manufacturing processes, improvement in supply chain strategies, supportive governmental policies and environmental and social considerations. This review offers a thorough insight into the evolving wind energy landscape with potential to satisfy increasing energy demands towards the major share of global electricity by 2050 while aiding climate objectives.

articleTitle: Implementation of an RFID-based community water management system in an irrigation system
abstract: Water is widely available resource that is shared by farmers in irrigation. Consequently, water management becomes a very intricate issue when the objective is to ensure fair distribution of resources and efficient utilization of water. Thus, in order to overcome these issues, farmer collaboration is essential. A centralized tube well access control system utilizing Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology is proposed in this research study as a means to enhance collaborative farming. While centralized tube wells provide a useful water source for many farmers, effective management of access is of the utmost importance. Secure and automated access for authorized farmers can be provided through the use of an RFID integration approach. Farmers can access the tube well by displaying their user-associated RFID cards or tags. A probabilistic evaluation utilizing a bi-level uncertainty approach verifies the robustness of the proposed system. In the initial level, a number of farmers try to gain access to the system.
